pictures.name: evening_hillside_above_the_camp
pictures.scene: a bare hillside of dry grass at the very end of the day with one small fire burning far below, the near slope lit warm and low, the ridge and the sky above it going quiet and deep and empty

pictures.name: open_window_to_the_night_sky
pictures.scene: a small unshuttered window cut through a thick stone wall with the night sky showing through it, the sill lit warm by a lamp at the bottom of the frame, the wall above the opening dark and plain

pictures.name: smoke_rising_at_sunset
pictures.scene: a low stone altar with one thin unbroken column of smoke lifting straight up from it, the embers and the stone lit warm and red at the bottom of the frame, the sunset sky above it deep and clear

pictures.name: closed_door_with_a_lamp_beside_it
pictures.scene: a plain timber door shut fast in a stone wall with one small lamp burning on the sill beside it, the door and the lamp lit warm and low, the wall rising above them dim and blank and quiet

pictures.name: path_forking_at_a_stone
pictures.scene: a footpath dividing in two beside one standing stone on open moorland, both tracks lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the country above them going flat and grey and featureless

pictures.name: laden_table_left_untouched
pictures.scene: a low table set with rich food and full cups and nothing disturbed on it at all, the nearest dishes lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the room above and behind it dim and empty

pictures.name: pruning_knife_and_cut_vine
pictures.scene: a curved pruning knife lying on the earth beside a vine freshly cut back to clean wood, the blade and the cut lit warm and hard low in the frame, the trellis above them quiet and dark and bare

pictures.name: sheer_cliff_edge_at_dusk
pictures.scene: the lip of a sheer cliff dropping away into shadow at dusk, the last of the light lying warm along the near rock, the great fall below and the sky beyond it dim and cold and holding no detail

pictures.name: still_air_over_a_quiet_valley
pictures.scene: a wide valley lying perfectly still in the last light with smoke standing straight above it, the near pasture lit warm and gold, the far slopes above them soft and blue and altogether without motion

pictures.name: broken_clods_on_new_ploughland
pictures.scene: heavy clods of freshly broken earth turned up across a field, the nearest ridges lit hard and low at the bottom of the frame, the ploughed ground beyond them running away dull and brown and open

pictures.name: single_star_over_a_dark_ridge
pictures.scene: one bright star hanging steady above a long dark ridge, the nearest rocks lit faintly at the bottom of the frame, the whole sky between them deep and clean and empty of any other light

pictures.name: net_spread_on_the_stones
pictures.scene: a fine mesh net spread wide and pegged out across flat stones, its cords lit hard and warm at the bottom of the frame, the bare ground beyond it running away pale and dry and out of the light

pictures.name: open_gap_in_the_thorn_hedge
pictures.scene: a clear open gap through a dense thorn hedge with the ground beyond it bright and level, the near thorns lit hard and low, the way through them warm and plain and standing entirely unobstructed

lines.text: A Psalm of David.
I call upon You, O LORD; come quickly to me.
Hear my voice when I call to You.
May my prayer be set before You like incense;
my uplifted hands, like the evening offering.
Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth;
keep watch at the door of my lips.
Do not let my heart be drawn to any evil thing
or take part in works of wickedness
with men who do iniquity;
let me not feast on their delicacies.
Let the righteous man strike me;
let his rebuke be an act of loving devotion.
It is oil for my head; let me not refuse it.
For my prayer is ever against the deeds of the wicked.
When their rulers are thrown down from the cliffs,
the people will listen to my words,
for they are pleasant.
As when one plows and breaks up the soil,
so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
But my eyes are fixed on You,
O GOD the Lord.
In You I seek refuge;
do not leave my soul defenseless.
Keep me from the snares they have laid for me,
and from the lures of evildoers.
Let the wicked fall into their own nets,
while I pass by in safety.
